title: Echo
subtitle: Feedback to product action for Creative Studio · Proposed pilot / not deployed
thesis: Agents assemble the evidence, draft the brief and draft every update; people make the three decisions that spend capacity or credibility: commit, verify, send.

bypass.note: Defer or decline: straight to the update

returns.label: comparable repeat test via Research Resi; remaining friction returns as new signals

panels.title: Audit / operating record
body: Requirements to verify in staging, not established protections: every agent and human write lands
in the activity log, attributed and timed; an agent write with no approval record shows in a saved view.
Per issue: decision log, verification log, send log (recipient, destination, text, result, remote link).

panels.title: Operating checks
body: Overdue decisions and deferrals due for review, by issue.
Committed → verified, with evidence. Updates sent vs owed, per contributor.
Denominators stated; missing data shown as missing, not zero.

feedback.label: overdue decisions go back to the decision-maker

caption: Design choice: three agent runs per issue (prepare, decision update, outcome update), each fired once by a status change. Native agents do not guarantee call counts; runs are counted in the activity log.

The agent never decides, never creates a delivery task, never marks verified, never posts without an approval record. Pilot is draft-only (L1); decisions and sends never promote. Proposed pilot / not deployed.
